name: kcg-civic-mcp-worker

scripts.test:budget-parser: rm -rf .tmp-budget-parser && tsc --ignoreConfig src/tools/budget.parser.ts --target ES2022 --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --outDir .tmp-budget-parser --skipLibCheck && node scripts/test-budget-parser.cjs && rm -rf .tmp-budget-parser
scripts.test:integrity: rm -rf .tmp-integrity && tsc --ignoreConfig src/utils/crypto.ts src/utils/integrity.ts src/models/types.ts src/kcc/client.ts src/kcc/search.ts src/kcc/proposal.ts src/kcc/identity.ts --target ES2022 --module node16 --moduleResolution node16 --outDir .tmp-integrity --skipLibCheck --types @cloudflare/workers-types && node scripts/test-integrity.cjs && rm -rf .tmp-integrity
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:budget-parser && npm run test:integrity && npm run test:oauth && npm run test:kcc-filters
scripts.predeploy: npm test && npm run verify:production-safety && npm run verify:toolchain
scripts.test:local-all: npm run test:local && npm run test:local-readback && node scripts/test-local-collector.mjs && npm run test:kcc-ingestion && npm run test:official-ingestion && npm run test:local-oauth && npm run test:local-oauth-integration && npm run test:local-ingress && node scripts/test-local-jobs.mjs
